item.title: Welcome to Torrington Community Radio
item.description: 2025 Best Non-Commercial Radio Station in Connecticut Connecticut Broadcasters Association WAPJ is an all-volunteer, listener-supported radio station licensed to the Torrington Community Radio Foundation, Inc. and has been serving the greater Torrington community for 27 years.
